---
title: "Reward Gradient Explorer"
subtitle: "How much is each consecutive strike worth?"
---

### What is "marginal value"?

If you replace one open frame with a strike, your total game score goes up. The **marginal value** is *how much* it goes up. For example, with a (5,4) open frame:

- The open scores 5 + 4 = **9 points**
- A strike under World Bowling scores **30 points**
- So the marginal value is 30 − 9 = **+21 points** — the same every time, regardless of when you throw it

Under traditional scoring, the marginal value **depends on context**, but it does not keep rising with the length of the run. The first two strikes of a run are discounted (+10 and +16) because their bonus balls fall on open frames. From the third strike onward every strike in the run is worth **+21** — exactly the same as under World Bowling. What compounds is the *total* value of the run, not the marginal value of each successive strike. The +37 for the 10th strike is a different kind of event: a tenth-frame strike is a three-ball strike, so it also adds its two bonus balls.

Use the slider below to see this in action. Try changing the fill type to confirm the pattern holds regardless of what the non-strike frames score.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

function scoreTraditional(balls) {
  let score = 0, i = 0;
  for (let frame = 0; frame < 10; frame++) {
    if (i >= balls.length) return null;
    if (frame < 9) {
      if (balls[i] === 10) {
        if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
        score += 10 + balls[i+1] + balls[i+2];
        i += 1;
      } else {
        if (i + 1 >= balls.length) return null;
        score += balls[i] + balls[i+1];
        if (balls[i] + balls[i+1] === 10) {
          if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
          score += balls[i+2];
        }
        i += 2;
      }
    } else {
      if (balls[i] === 10) {
        if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
        score += 10 + balls[i+1] + balls[i+2];
      } else {
        if (i + 1 >= balls.length) return null;
        if (balls[i] + balls[i+1] === 10) {
          if (i + 2 >= balls.length) return null;
          score += 10 + balls[i+2];
        } else {
          score += balls[i] + balls[i+1];
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return score;
}

function scoreWorld(balls) {
  let score = 0, i = 0;
  for (let frame = 0; frame < 10; frame++) {
    if (i >= balls.length) return null;
    if (balls[i] === 10) {
      score += 30; i += 1;
    } else {
      if (i + 1 >= balls.length) return null;
      if (balls[i] + balls[i+1] === 10) score += 10 + balls[i];
      else score += balls[i] + balls[i+1];
      i += 2;
    }
  }
  return score;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof nStrikes = Inputs.range([0, 10], {value: 5, step: 1, label: "Consecutive strikes (frames 1–N)"})
viewof fillType = Inputs.select(["5,4 (mid)", "3,2 (weak)", "8,1 (strong)", "7,2 (mid-high)"], {label: "Non-strike fill", value: "5,4 (mid)"})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

fillBalls = {
  const map = {"5,4 (mid)": [5,4], "3,2 (weak)": [3,2], "8,1 (strong)": [8,1], "7,2 (mid-high)": [7,2]};
  return map[fillType];
}

gradientData = {
  let rows = [];
  for (let n = 0; n <= 10; n++) {
    let balls = [];
    if (n === 10) {
      balls = Array(12).fill(10);
    } else {
      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) balls.push(10);
      // open frames filling frames n+1..9 and the tenth frame
      for (let i = 0; i < 9 - n; i++) balls = balls.concat(fillBalls);
      balls = balls.concat(fillBalls);
    }
    let t = scoreTraditional(balls);
    let w = scoreWorld(balls);
    let tm = n > 0 ? t - rows[n-1].trad : 0;
    let wm = n > 0 ? w - rows[n-1].world : 0;
    rows.push({strikes: n, trad: t, world: w, tradMarginal: tm, worldMarginal: wm, current: n === nStrikes});
  }
  return rows;
}

currentRow = gradientData[nStrikes]
```

### Full table

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(gradientData, {
  columns: ["strikes", "trad", "world", "tradMarginal", "worldMarginal"],
  header: {
    strikes: "Consecutive Strikes",
    trad: "Traditional Score",
    world: "World Bowling Score",
    tradMarginal: "Trad. Marginal",
    worldMarginal: "WB Marginal"
  },
  format: {
    tradMarginal: d => d > 0 ? `+${d}` : d === 0 ? "—" : d,
    worldMarginal: d => d > 0 ? `+${d}` : d === 0 ? "—" : d,
  }
})
```

## What to notice

- **Traditional marginal value is +10, +16, then flat at +21** — it does not keep rising as the run extends
- **World Bowling marginal is flat at +21** — every strike adds the same amount regardless of context
- **The tenth strike's +37 is a three-ball artefact**, not a compounding bonus: the tenth-frame strike also adds its two bonus balls
- Change the fill type to confirm the +10/+16/+21 pattern is structural, not an artefact of the non-strike value
